quarter_ending: To analyze Netflix’s quarterly revenue and membership streaming trends and forecast future revenue.
The quarterly for the years 2017 - 2024 was collected.
The data was collected from Netflix’s official website, which includes their financial releases for quarterly and annual earnings
Why does this data set intrigue you?
This data interests me because I love watching Netflix’s true crime documentary series and any docuseries they produce.
Their business strategy and marketing approach always fascinate me because they demonstrate unique and out-of-the-box thinking, which I truly appreciate.
I wanted to see how much their revenue changes with big series or movie they release each month.
